description: Make a calendar invite for one chosen meeting time across time zones: a Time of Meeting planner link, plus optional paste-ready text, an .ics calendar file, a Google Calendar link, or a QR code. Use once the meeting time is chosen. duration_minutes is the meeting length, chosen now, with the same choices as the planner Duration control. title is an optional meeting name, e.g. Weekly sync. Each city says whether that date is a public holiday. Includes a Time of Meeting planner link alongside calendar links. Planner link: open this meeting on timeofmeeting.com (see and adjust it in the planner). formats adds text to paste into a chat or email, a calendar file for Outlook, Apple Calendar and most calendar apps, an add-to-Google-Calendar link, or a QR code image someone can scan with a phone, in that order. The calendar file is https://timeofmeeting.com/c?q=.

cities.description: Two to eight cities. A list of strings. Each item is one city. A comma in an item adds a region, state or country to that city; it is not a second city. One city: a name, a city id from a city search, an IANA time zone such as Europe/Copenhagen, or a zone abbreviation or fixed offset such as EST, CET, UTC or UTC+2. A comma adds a region, state or country to that one city, for example "Paris, France", "Paris, TX" or "Munich, Bavaria"; it is not a second city. Multiple cities must be separate list items, for example ["Berlin","Rome"]. Spelling and accents are flexible. When several cities share a name, the best match from the site search is used and the others come back in alternatives.

duration_minutes.description: Meeting length in minutes, chosen when the invitation is made. Same choices as the planner Duration control: 15, 30, 45, 60, 90, 120, or any whole number from 5 to 1440 in steps of 5. Default 30.

formats.description: Formats to include alongside the Time of Meeting planner link: open this meeting on timeofmeeting.com (see and adjust it in the planner). Returned in this order: text (text to paste into a chat or email), ics (calendar file for Outlook, Apple Calendar and most calendar apps), google (add-to-Google-Calendar link), qr (QR code image someone can scan with a phone). Default when omitted: ["text", "ics", "google"]. An empty array returns the planner link only. qr is included only when requested.

start.description: ISO time with Z or an offset, or a local time in the first city (YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM). An offset such as 2027-10-31T02:30+02:00 selects that instant when the clock time happens twice. A time alone, such as 09:00, is that time today in the first city.

title.description: Optional meeting name, e.g. Weekly sync. It is the calendar event name and the first line of the text. When omitted, the invitation stays as it is now.

name: create_meeting_link

alternatives.description: Other cities that matched the same name, after the best-ranked city was chosen. The order is the site search order: match, then priority, then population.

weeks.description: ISO week (Monday start; week 1 contains the year's first Thursday) and US week (Sunday start; 1 January is week 1 of that calendar year).

zone_notes.description: Present when a city argument was a time zone abbreviation or fixed offset such as EST or UTC+2. Says which time zone it was read as, and what else the abbreviation can mean.

title: Create a meeting link
